title: Mark Walter and Todd Boehly selling stakes in Chelsea Football Club to Clearlake Capital
summary: Mark Walter and Todd Boehly are selling their stakes in Chelsea Football Club to Clearlake Capital amid federal investigations into Walter's insurance companies' accounting of $21 billion in transactions.
content: Two of Walter's insurance companies faces federal criminal and civil investigations into the accounting of roughly $21 billion in financial transactions.

title: Trump plans to meet Gulf leaders at UN next week on Iran war's endgame: report
summary: Trump plans to meet Gulf state leaders at the UN next week to discuss ending the Iran conflict, as Washington's ceasefire negotiation efforts have stalled while Gulf nations face escalating attacks from Iran and Houthi militants.
content: Washington's efforts for resuming ceasefire talks appear to have stalled, as Gulf states absorb escalating attacks from Iran and Iran-aligned Houthi militants.

zh.title: 特朗普计划下周在联合国与海湾领导人会面讨论伊朗战争的终局：报道
zh.summary: 特朗普计划下周在联合国与海湾国家领导人会面讨论结束伊朗冲突，因为华盛顿的停火谈判努力已陷入停滞，而海湾国家面临来自伊朗和胡塞武装分子的不断升级的攻击。

title: Japan’s corporate leaders sound alarm over weak yen — even dollar-earners are voicing concerns
summary: Japanese corporate leaders express concern about the weak yen despite its recent rapid strengthening, citing ongoing economic challenges from historically low currency values.
content: While the Japanese yen has strengthened rapidly over the past two weeks, it remains weak in historical terms.

zh.title: 日本企业领导人对日元走弱敲响警钟——即使是美元收入企业也在表达担忧
zh.summary: 日本企业领导人对日元走弱表示担忧，尽管日元最近迅速升值，他们引用了历史低点货币价值带来的持续经济挑战。

title: OpenAI reveals six more safety issues and unveils plan to disclose incidents
summary: OpenAI disclosed six new safety incidents and announced a comprehensive system for tracking, investigating, and publicly disclosing cases of model misalignment and misbehavior.
content: The firm also announced a new system to track, investigate and disclose cases of models misbehaving, or "misalignment".

zh.title: OpenAI披露六项新安全问题并公布事件披露计划
zh.summary: OpenAI披露了六项新的安全事件，并公布了一个用于追踪、调查和公开披露模型错误和不当行为案例的全面系统。

title: Oil extends losses as Saudi Arabia reportedly offers ship-to-ship crude transfers after pipeline hit
summary: Oil prices declined after Saudi Arabia announced plans to use ship-to-ship crude transfers following a pipeline strike, easing market concerns about disruptions to the kingdom's exports.
content: Oil prices fell as additional Saudi crude supplies eased concerns over disruptions to the kingdom’s exports.

title: Stock futures rise after Fed's rate hike spurs a market sell-off: Live updates
summary: Stock futures rose following the Federal Reserve's widely-anticipated 0.25% interest rate increase and signals of potential additional hikes later this year.
content: In a widely anticipated move, the Fed raised the overnight funds rate by a quarter percentage point and signaled another hike could come this year.

title: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate-membership proposal
summary: Trump threatened the EU with tariffs over its proposal to grant Canada associate membership status, calling it a hostile act that could undermine the bloc's structure.
content: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
summary: The Federal Reserve unanimously raised US interest rates for the first time in three years by 0.25%, ignoring fierce opposition from President Trump who had called for rate cuts.
content: Rates were hiked in a unanimous decision despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had called for a cut.

title: Why Trump's hand-picked Fed chair defied him by raising interest rates
summary: Trump's hand-picked Federal Reserve chair demonstrated independence by raising interest rates by 0.25% despite the president's public opposition and calls for rate cuts.
content: The 0.25% increase comes despite fierce opposition from the US president, who has called for rates to be cut.

title: Inside India newsletter: The world’s largest real-time payments system will no longer be free for all
summary: India's large-scale real-time payments system, which currently processes over one million free transactions every two minutes, will begin charging merchant fees.
content: India's digital payment system, which processes more than 1 million transactions every two minutes for free now, will start charging fees to merchants.

zh.title: 印度通讯：全球最大实时支付系统将不再向所有人免费
